cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

mechanism: A supervises team registration to secure B's visible allegiance before explaining the final-round penalty.
confusable: D190 processes a request; D199 intentionally gets commitment before stakes are clear.
comparison: Group badge and visible allegiance differ from a legally styled joint stall entry.
seedUse: Keep badge refusal but make B's alternate support offer produce a real recruitment tactic.
